_note: Illustrative approximation of real program structure for a hackathon demo. Figures are synthetic and must not be relied on operationally.
_coverageNote: Arrearage Management Programs exist in some states and not others. CA and TX are deliberately absent — that absence is part of the demo.

programs.name: Illinois Arrearage Reduction Credit
programs.citation: Illinois arrearage reduction credit administered alongside the state PIPP
programs.administeredBy: Illinois Department of Commerce and Economic Opportunity

intakeVia.name: Community and Economic Development Association of Cook County (CEDA)

criteria.text: Household income at or below 200% of the Federal Poverty Level.
Account carries at least $250 in arrears.
Customer is enrolled in the Illinois Percentage of Income Payment Plan.

forgiveness.text: For each on-time monthly payment, a credit of up to $150 is applied against pre-existing arrears, for up to 12 months.

programs.name: New York Energy Affordability Program arrears credit
programs.citation: NYPSC Energy Affordability Program — arrears forgiveness component

intakeVia.name: Utility-administered enrolment
intakeVia.note: Enrolment is automatic for HEAP recipients — the customer does not apply separately.

criteria.text: Household received a HEAP benefit in the current program year.
Account carries at least $100 in arrears.

forgiveness.text: Arrears are credited down over up to 24 months while the customer stays current on the affordable monthly amount.
